reason_for_clarification: Sentence 1 ('retry the payment up to 3 times') counts retries after the first attempt (up to 4 attempts in total under the strict reading), while sentence 3 ('After 3 failed attempts ... switch') counts attempts in total, so the two count rules contradicted each other. Found in the Phase 7 remediation verification (E08). Owner-approved interpretation: three additional retries after the initial failed payment attempt, giving a maximum of four total attempts.

document.title: Payment Failure and Retry Policy
document.text: If a payment fails, the order is not placed and the customer can retry the payment up to 3 times within 30 minutes while the cart prices stay locked. If money was debited for a failed payment, it is automatically reversed to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days, and no claim needs to be raised. After 3 failed attempts the customer should switch to another payment method such as UPI, a different card, net banking or cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available only for orders up to ₹10,000 and only at pin codes where it is offered.
